evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/operator/cli.rs
evidence.finding: Rust CLI exposes project/instance/configure/run/up/down/logs/status/doctor/runtime/skill/channel/continuity/job. Run supports operator TUI, plain driven mode and bounded attached runtime TUI.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/api/mod.rs
evidence.finding: Local /v0 API exposes session turns/history/actions, channel pairing/outbox/attachments, policy grants, jobs, continuity and audit; no human account middleware is installed.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/daemon.rs
evidence.finding: Daemon starts scheduler and attachment maintenance independently of interactive console; default binds 127.0.0.1:8979. Tracing prints local logs.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/kernel/core.rs
evidence.locator: KernelOptions, session_action, spawn_session_action, session_lock and turn_session
evidence.finding: Kernel serializes turns per session, tracks cancellation, persists canonical turns and resumes/retries through runtime drivers. Distinct sessions can progress independently; no task hierarchy schema.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/operator/runtime.rs
evidence.finding: Configured native Codex app-server and ACP protocol drivers are registered; mock is test-only default built-in. OpenCode uses ACP; arbitrary ACP executable profiles require configuration.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw-runtime-codex/src/adapter.rs
evidence.finding: Native Codex driver starts/resumes stored thread IDs and maps driven turn events; attached native TUI does not import canonical transcript.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw-runtime-acp/src/adapter.rs
evidence.finding: ACP adapter persists session identity and supports cancellation; runtime/provider retains model/auth semantics.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/kernel/runtime/execution/oci.rs
evidence.finding: Podman confines runtime processes, mounts workspace/private native home, masks .lionclaw metadata, configures network on/none and optional read-only rootfs/CPU/memory/PID limits. Containers are removed after execution; persistent mounted state survives.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/kernel/policy.rs
evidence.finding: SQLite grants name skill, capability, scope and optional expiry; absent/expired matching grant denies privileged operations.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/kernel/runtime_policy.rs
evidence.finding: Working-directory roots, environment passthrough allowlist and timeout bounds validate requested execution context.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/kernel/capability_broker.rs
evidence.finding: Kernel derives channel authority from active turn/project inventory, validates route selection and attachment intents. Privileged dispatch stays outside confined agent.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/kernel/jobs.rs
evidence.finding: Persistent jobs support once/interval/cron with timezone, retries, running ownership and run/delivery status. These are schedules, not a general issue backlog.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/kernel/scheduler.rs
evidence.finding: Daemon scheduler claims a lease, reconciles interrupted work/delivery and awaits each due job sequentially in fresh conservative sessions. After the tick completes it sleeps30seconds. Retries and run/delivery states persist; independent interactive sessions are a separate concurrency path.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/kernel/continuity.rs
evidence.locator: ContinuityLayout; record_artifact, open-loop/proposal methods and search
evidence.finding: Markdown memory, daily events, open loops, artifacts and proposals persist locally; proposals merge/reject and archive, search rebuilds index or scans Markdown.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/kernel/private_context_projection.rs
evidence.finding: Typed private context distinguishes user/assistant/memory classes, byte/item budgets and source provenance; default no-op projector unless configured.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/kernel/audit.rs
evidence.finding: SQLite audit events retain UUID, actor label, session, event type, details and UTC timestamp; query limits/filtering exist but no cryptographic chain.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw-channel-team-local/src/worker.rs
evidence.finding: Addressed project-instance messages resolve known members, validate daemon/home identity and actor authorization, and deliver through durable outbox. Reply refs are rejected; send another addressed message.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/operator/target.rs
evidence.locator: init_project, create_project_instance, discovery and work-root validation
evidence.finding: Project instances have local homes and explicit work roots; discovery checks current/parent directories. No Git worktree/branch creation is performed here.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/operator/run_tui/render.rs
evidence.finding: Ratatui operator console shows current conversation, recent sessions, runtime/boundary status and input. It is not a browser or desktop GUI.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/runtime_timeouts.rs
evidence.finding: Interactive driven turns default 30-minute idle/two-hour hard; daemon 30-minute idle/four-hour hard, with configurable explicit timeouts.

evidence.title: LionClaw: crates/lionclaw/src/kernel/session_turns.rs
evidence.locator: session turn journal persistence and event records
evidence.finding: Canonical driven turns retain ordered events; raw protocol payload retention is debug-only and KernelOptions defaults false.
